errors.text_span: The chart is arranged with the largest segment starting at the top right and proceeding clockwise
errors.evidence: The slices are not arranged in any discernible order (e.g., by size) in a clockwise direction. Following the slices clockwise from the largest one does not reveal any pattern, making this statement a description of a non-existent structural feature.

The description uses the generic term "orange" for both the "Game&Anime" slice and the "Pet & Animal" slice, even though they are visually distinct shades (dark orange and light orange, respectively). This creates ambiguity.
